name: Home Alone: Anomalies
desc:
You're home alone. Unexpected visitors keep arriving at your door, but not everyone is who they claim to be. Decide who to trust and survive the night.

How to Play:
📷 Check the cameras
👂 Listen to what they say
🚪 Open the door if they need help
🔦 Turn off the porch light if something is off...
💰 Survive the night and earn enough cash
🎭 Troll your friends with jump scare items!

UPDATE 12 (10.10.2026): 
- Halloween Event! Collect pumpkins & unlock the Halloween Pass
- Costumed Visitors
- New Pets (Black Cat, White Cat, Crawler Cat)
- Top 100 Pumpkin Leaderboard (Celestial Cat reward)
- Bug Fixes
& More!
